scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c magenta,cyan "pnpm -C frontend dev" "uv run --directory backend fastapi dev app/main.py --port 8000"
scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory backend python -m app.openapi_dump > backend/openapi.json && pnpm -C frontend exec openapi-typescript ../backend/openapi.json -o src/api/schema.d.ts
scripts.test: pnpm -C frontend test && uv run --directory backend pytest
scripts.lint: pnpm -C frontend lint && uv run --directory backend ruff check
